title: 第3章 如果是死刑呢第4章 入室抢劫
slug: 律师霸凌者无罪我送他死刑
content_zh:
无非就是几个校霸耍点小聪明，威胁王大哥的儿子自己伤害自己，这样就能撇乾净关係而已。
你也拿不到对方直接实施暴力证据。
所以不论是学校还是警方不想麻烦，直接给下了一个“自己摔的”离谱定论。
但大部分律师还真不知道如何应对这种情况。
红圈所的金牌律师都败诉了，可见处理起来还是有些复杂的。
王大海这边听闻，眼睛立马闪出了一丝希望。
直接就接受了。
“好的！我马上过来”
无论如何，这么复杂的案件，这个律师一下子就猜中了，那说明这个律师实力还是有的！
王大海准备试一试！
说完，他掛断了电话。
这下直播间又热闹了起来，但眾人都瞬间意识到了一个严重的问题！
林默竟然要给王大海打官司！
“等等！这是准备找林律师打官司了？”
“这就接官司了？！”
“糟了！林大律师分析对了几个法律问题，觉得自己又行了！”
“臥槽！大海叔糊涂啊！找谁不好，硬要找林默？！”
“哥，林大律师，大海叔已经够惨了，您手下留情，放大海叔一马行不，这官司咱们不接！”
虽然今天林默的法律諮询表现出了不错的专业性。
更新不易，记得分享101看书网

但谁都知道，理论分析和实战可不是两个不同的概念！
但大家可没忘记林默的逆天战绩啊！
说是帮大海叔打官司，但有没有一种可能，林默会把大海叔也坑进去？
有前车之鑑，让观眾们不得不怀疑啊。
林默看到直播间大家的疑虑，没有回应。
而是翻看起了平台上有关王大海的发布的切片。
王大海也是江海人，住在郊区的农村中。
王大海自己的帐號被以传播谣言封禁，但是很多网友都被自发的保存了下来，帮助传播。
视频上，一个带著工地安全帽的沧桑男人，雨声泪下的讲述著儿子遭受的伤害。
看得出来，王大海家里条件不怎么样，甚至可以说是贫穷。
上一次请的那个號称金牌律师的，一定了不少钱。
所以他进直播间諮询的时候，才问需不需要钱。
弱势的可怜人啊。
林默无奈的摇了摇头，然后在直播间说道：
“老铁们，今天的直播就到这里了，我要去收集相关信息了，等我凯旋。”
见林默是真准备打官司，观眾们都急了。
“不是！林大律师您就別给大海叔添乱了！”
“我很佩服主播的勇气，但是我怀疑主播的实力。”
“完犊子了，林大律师出手，这下本就弱势的大海叔更是雪上加霜了！”
林默看到这些评论，有些无奈。

看得出来网友们確实很担心，没办法，前主打的两场案子实在是惊骇世俗。
网友担忧也是正常的。
“好了，诸位就等我的好消息吧。”
说著，林默关闭了直播间。
content_en:
It's nothing more than a few school bullies trying to be clever and threatening Brother Wang's son to hurt themselves, so that the relationship can be cleared.
You also can’t get evidence that the other party directly committed violence.
Therefore, both the school and the police did not want to cause trouble and directly concluded that "he fell by himself".
But most lawyers really don’t know how to handle this situation.
All the top lawyers from Red Circle firms have lost the case, which shows that the handling is still a bit complicated.
When Wang Dahai heard this, his eyes immediately flashed with hope.
I accepted it directly.
"Okay! I'll be right over"
In any case, this lawyer guessed such a complicated case right away, which shows that this lawyer is still very capable!
Wang Dahai is ready to give it a try!
After saying that, he hung up the phone.
Now the live broadcast room became lively again, but everyone instantly realized a serious problem!
Lin Mo actually wanted to file a lawsuit against Wang Dahai!
"Wait! Are you planning to file a lawsuit with Lawyer Lin?"
"A lawsuit now?!"
"Oops! Attorney Lin analyzed several legal issues correctly and feels that he is good again!"
"Damn it! Uncle Dahai is so confused! You can't find anyone to look for, but you insist on looking for Lin Mo?!"
"Brother, Barrister Lin, Uncle Hai is already miserable enough. Can you be merciful and aggravate Uncle Hai? We will not accept this lawsuit!"
Although Lin Mo's legal consultation today showed good professionalism.
It’s not easy to update, remember to share with 101 Kanshu.com
But everyone knows that theoretical analysis and practical combat are not two different concepts!
But everyone has not forgotten Lin Mo’s incredible record!
It is said that he is helping Uncle Dahai with the lawsuit, but is there a possibility that Lin Mo will trick Uncle Dahai into it?
There are lessons learned from the past, so the audience has to doubt it.
Lin Mo saw everyone's doubts in the live broadcast room and did not respond.
Instead, he looked through the slices of Wang Dahai’s releases on the platform.
Wang Dahai is also from Jianghai and lives in a rural area on the outskirts.
Wang Dahai's own account was banned for spreading rumors, but many netizens spontaneously saved it and helped spread it.
On the video, a vicissitudes of life man wearing a construction site safety helmet described the injuries suffered by his son with tears in his eyes.
It can be seen that Wang Dahai's family conditions are not very good, and can even be said to be poor.
The so-called golden lawyer I hired last time must have paid a lot of money.
That's why when he entered the live broadcast room for consultation, he asked if he needed money.
Poor weak man.
Lin Mo shook his head helplessly, and then said in the live broadcast room:
"Old fellows, today's live broadcast ends here. I'm going to collect relevant information and wait for my triumphant return."
Seeing that Lin Mo was really preparing to file a lawsuit, the audience became anxious.
"No! Counselor Lin, please stop causing trouble to Uncle Dahai!"
"I admire the anchor's courage, but I doubt the anchor's ability."
"It's over. Lawyer Lin takes action. Uncle Dahai, who is already weak, is even worse!"
Lin Mo felt helpless when he saw these comments.
It can be seen that netizens are really worried, and there is nothing they can do about it. The two cases that the former protagonist has been involved in are really shocking to the world.
It is normal for netizens to be worried.
"Okay, everyone just wait for my good news."
With that said, Lin Mo closed the live broadcast room.
